(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (num-list< a b)
      (cond [(empty? a) #f]
            [(< (first a) (first b)) #t]
            [(> (first a) (first b)) #f]
            [else (num-list< (rest a) (rest b))]))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (num-list< (list (first a) (second a))
                 (list (first b) (second b))))
    (define (norm cells)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r0 (first bb))
             (c0 (second bb)))
        (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0))) cells) cell<)))
    (define (obj< a b)
      (cell< (first (sort (obj-cells a) cell<))
             (first (sort (obj-cells b) cell<))))
    (define (colors-reading grid)
      (remove-duplicates
       (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p)))
            (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                    (grid-positions grid)))))
    (define (majority-color grid)
      (first
       (sort (filter (lambda (color) (not (member? color (list 1 3))))
                     (colors-reading grid))
             (lambda (a b)
               (num-list< (list (- (length (find-color grid a))) (- a))
                          (list (- (length (find-color grid b))) (- b)))))))
    (define (exact-matches grid)
      (let* ((template (first (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 1)) (objects grid 0))))
             (target (norm (obj-cells template))))
        (sort
         (filter (lambda (obj)
                   (and (= (obj-color obj) 3)
                        (equal? (norm (obj-cells obj)) target)))
                 (objects grid 0))
         obj<)))
    (define (stage-a grid color)
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0)])
                ([obj (in-list (exact-matches grid))])
        (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color)))
    (define (manhattan a b)
      (+ (abs (- (first a) (first b)))
         (abs (- (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (pair-key pair)
      (let ((a (first pair)) (b (second pair)))
        (list (manhattan a b)
              (first a) (second a) (first b) (second b))))
    (define (pair< a b) (num-list< (pair-key a) (pair-key b)))
    (define (closest-pair left right)
      (first
       (sort (for*/list ([a (in-list left)] [b (in-list right)]) (list a b)) pair<)))
    (define (horizontal-first-cells a b)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append
        (for/list ([c (in-range (min (second a) (second b))
                                (+ 1 (max (second a) (second b))))])
          (list (first a) c))
        (for/list ([r (in-range (min (first a) (first b))
                                (+ 1 (max (first a) (first b))))])
          (list r (second b))))))
    (define (connect-chain stage color)
      (let ((parts (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color))
                                 (objects stage 0))
                         obj<)))
        (let loop ([remaining parts] [out stage])
          (if (or (empty? remaining) (empty? (rest remaining)))
              out
              (let* ((pair (closest-pair (obj-cells (first remaining))
                                         (obj-cells (second remaining))))
                     (cells (horizontal-first-cells (first pair) (second pair))))
                (loop (rest remaining) (paint-cells out cells color)))))))
    (let* ((color (majority-color g))
           (intermediate (stage-a g color)))
      (connect-chain intermediate color))))
